definition: Changing behaviour or direction unpredictably and without clear reason.
author: Washington Irving
quote: In the fullness of their revelry, they fluttered, chirping and frolicking from bush to bush, and tree to tree, capricious from the very profusion and variety around them.
example_sentence: The capricious spring weather changed every hour.
